proof_summary: Taking \(p=11\), direct evaluation of the finite weighted sum gives \(44\pmod{121}\). The character used in the formal statement is \(\left(\frac{7}{11}\right)=-1\) (the arguments are reversed from the canonical \(\left(\frac{11}{7}\right)\)), so the claimed right-hand side is \(11(21(-1)+16)=-55\equiv66\pmod{121}\), yielding a contradiction.
